name: marketing-hover-galleries
title: Hover Galleries
description: Original image galleries that cycle through several photos on hover, in three distinct transition styles.
useWhen: Original image galleries that cycle through several photos on hover, in three distinct transition styles.
avoidWhen: Avoid hover galleries when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Hover Galleries uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
